sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Correct the direct comparison: thrusterResistanceCapacity must be greater than or equal to thrusterIceImpactDemand, so the query must fail when capacityValue < demandValue only if that condition is explicitly reported as nonconformance, or otherwise encode the passing comparison as capacityValue >= demandValue. Also add a required thrusterResistanceCapacity quantity shape on the linked thrusterBody, with minCount 1, maxCount 1, and unit qudt:KiloN; currently capacity is only mentioned in the query and its required result presence and declared unit are not enforced. Preserve the prior datatype and identifier instructions and the existing inverse-path minCount for equivalentImpactSphereRadius.

rows: Remove the mandatory thrusterIceImpactLoadCaseIdentifier constraint: it is not a semantic obligation or a non-empty dependency-contract field for TRF-114, so requiring it invents an additional readiness requirement. Retain the declared owner/path, table references, operands, direct capacity-versus-demand check, conditional geometry branches, radius, and explicitly required evidence constraints.

Remove the guessed xsd:decimal restrictions: canonical metadata for the quantity properties does not declare a datatype. This includes every sh:datatype xsd:decimal constraint on qudt:numericValue and the datatype(?radiusValue) = xsd:decimal filter in the radius query; retain the declared QUDT units and all existing owner/path, applicability, alternative, evidence, and capacity-versus-demand checks. The prior instruction to omit thrusterIceImpactLoadCaseIdentifier remains satisfied.

Retain the prior datatype and identifier instructions. In the non-hemispherical branch, add sh:minCount 1 to the outer inverse-path property [ sh:path [ sh:inversePath nltl:hasThrusterIceImpactLoadCase ] ; ... ] that leads to the ship and its equivalentImpactSphereRadius. Without that cardinality, absence of any linked ship node makes the nested radius requirement vacuously pass, omitting the required radius operand.

Correct the direct comparison: thrusterResistanceCapacity must be greater than or equal to thrusterIceImpactDemand, so the query must fail when capacityValue < demandValue only if that condition is explicitly reported as nonconformance, or otherwise encode the passing comparison as capacityValue >= demandValue. Also add a required thrusterResistanceCapacity quantity shape on the linked thrusterBody, with minCount 1, maxCount 1, and unit qudt:KiloN; currently capacity is only mentioned in the query and its required result presence and declared unit are not enforced. Preserve the prior datatype and identifier instructions and the existing inverse-path minCount for equivalentImpactSphereRadius.
